title: The credibility of the US Federal Reserve, the world's most powerful financial institution, is at risk
subhead: The Fed faces a challenging period. Inflation has remained above its 2% target for five years, Donald Trump has attacked its independence and Kevin Warsh's tenure as chair has started turbulently. His speech in Jackson Hole on August 28 is shaping up to be crucial.

In Gaza's hospitals, shortages and obstructed evacuations put patients at risk: 'We are forced to use the same catheter 20 or 30 times'
subhead: In the Palestinian enclave, 95% of hospitals have been destroyed or damaged, leaving them desperately short of equipment and supplies. There are no MRI machines left, and only two CT scanners remain. Around 20,000 patients are on the evacuation list.

title: Donald Trump undermines surrogacy for foreign nationals in the United States
subhead: A recent executive order from the US president ends the right to American citizenship for children born via surrogacy when the intended parents are foreign nationals. Washington's main targets are Chinese nationals, the largest group using US surrogacy services, followed by the French.

title: 'Colossal' theme park project near Paris unveiled as  Saudi Arabia's MBS visits France
subhead: Mohammed bin Salman's visit to France, which coincided with the first meeting of the French-Saudi Strategic Partnership Council on Monday, August 24, was marked by a series of commercial announcements and diplomatic considerations.

title: 'Citizens no longer trusted us': Belgium's attempt to revive democracy
subhead: 'Room for Hope' (1/6). High voter abstention, unfulfilled political promises and the growing influence of authoritarian movements have weakened democracies. In response to this crisis, Belgian writer David Van Reybrouck is behind numerous initiatives that hope to reinvigorate democratic practice.

subhead: In an interview, the Japanese writer recalls how, from being a passionate reader, he suddenly became a creator one day in April 1978. Sometimes worn down by critics, the author believes it is very difficult to persevere in literature.

title: Want peace and quiet in France? These are the best places to buy property
subhead: For many people in France, the goal is to hear only the sounds of nature and to avoid being caught up in a tide of tourists. The good news is that in most areas where peace and quiet can still be found, real estate prices remain low.

title: Mexico's tourist beaches grapple with sargassum crisis
subhead: This year has brought unprecedented volumes of brown algae to the beaches of the Yucatán Peninsula, four times higher than in 2025. The country is turning to science and technology to better predict and counter these invasions.
